[P4] 出版者的话
古希腊圣哲亚里士多德曾说：“任何人都会生气，这没什么难的，但若要适时适所地以适当方式对适当对象恰如其分地生气，可就难上加难了。”我们现在讲的情绪管理指的就是要适时适所地对适当对象恰如其分地表达情绪。
现实生活中，人们越来越多地认识到情绪管理能力的重要性，因为这方面能力出众的人往往在各个领域都游刃有余；相反，此项能力差的人，虽然可能很聪明，但做起事来往往很吃力。
情绪管理能力虽部分得益于先天因素，但归根结底还得靠后天的学习和培养。幼儿时期是情绪管理能力培养的黄金时期，一个人在幼儿时期所获得的情绪经验和习惯会在大脑中形成永久的神经联结，对其身心发展影响很长远。
当前，亲子共读情绪管理类图画书这种情绪管理能力培养方式已被广泛认可。优质的图画书好比幸福的种子，通过父母的声音飞进孩子的耳朵里，植根在孩子的心底，施以阳光、雨露就能生根、发芽。
这套有趣的动物图画故事书温情脉脉，每一本都是有针对性地就孩子的某一种情绪话题展开，描绘孩子的心路历程，揭示其走出情绪困扰并解决问题的过程。每一本书都附有幼教专家精心撰写的导读，可作为家长亲子共读时的参考。
让我们在这套书的陪伴下，去享受一段美妙的亲子阅读之旅吧！

一定很累。妈妈绞尽脑汁想个不停，要为她的小蛇找点事做。可是，小蛇
科斯太聪明了，他学东西特别快，一旦他学会了，就又觉得无聊了。每次，
他学会一项本领后，总会回到妈妈身边，问妈妈同一个问题：“妈妈，我
现在该做什么呢？”蛇妈妈累极了。可是，小蛇科斯不累啊，他说：“我
无聊！”

聪明的蛇妈妈突然想到了一个奇妙的点子！她让小蛇科斯去找毛毛虫
学习怎样变蝴蝶。让你的宝贝大胆猜想一下：这一次，小蛇科斯学会了吗？无论孩子说出怎样的答案，都不要否定，继续读故事吧。当读到“蛇

[P6] 情感，和孩子一起分享美好的亲子时光。
孩子跟大人一样，有各种各样的情绪。你知道吗？有时候孩子表现出来的“无聊”“没意思”，并不是在无理取闹，而是因为他们没有办法长时间专注于一件事情。如果孩子总是不停地问你：“我现在该做什么呢？”你一次次地建议，越来越烦躁，最后恼怒地告诉他：“你想做什么就去做什么吧！”这说明你不能准确识别孩子行为中透露的情绪“密码”。让孩子感到不无聊的最有效办法就是——陪伴。小蛇科斯在妈妈的怀抱里觉得好舒服，甚至忘了问：“我现在该做什么呢？”这就是陪伴的力量，可以缓解孩子的不良情绪。
请你试着将孩子拥在怀里，读一读绘本《小蛇好无聊》吧，比起单纯的说教，孩子更容易对故事里的情节感同身受。跟孩子一起阅读，你就能在不知不觉间告诉孩子：这个世界真的有很多很多快乐的、有意思的事情！妈妈的爱，永远是最温暖的，可以战胜无聊，让孩子感受到关爱，感受到幸福。
（石家庄市第二幼儿园 谷红岩）

[P4] Publisher's Note
The ancient Greek philosopher Aristotle once said: 'Everyone gets angry; that's not difficult. But to get angry at the right time, in the right place, with the right person, and in the right way—well, that's difficult indeed.' What we now call emotional management is precisely about expressing emotions appropriately, at the right time, in the right place, and toward the right person.
In real life, people are increasingly recognizing the importance of emotional management skills, because those who excel in this area often thrive in various fields; conversely, those who lack this skill, though possibly intelligent, often find things difficult.
While emotional management skills are partly influenced by innate factors, they ultimately depend on learning and cultivation over time. Early childhood is the golden period for developing emotional management skills. The emotional experiences and habits formed during this period create lasting neural connections in the brain, profoundly influencing a child's physical and mental development.
Currently, the practice of parent-child reading of emotional management picture books is widely recognized as an effective way to cultivate emotional intelligence. High-quality picture books are like seeds of happiness, carried into children's ears by parents' voices, taking root in their hearts, and growing with sunlight and rain.
This series of heartwarming animal storybooks addresses specific emotional topics for children, depicting their inner journeys and revealing how they overcome emotional challenges and solve problems. Each book includes a carefully written guide by early childhood education experts, serving as a valuable reference for parents during shared reading.
Let us enjoy a wonderful parent-child reading journey together with this series!

[P5] Teacher Says to You

The Power of Companionship

"What should I do now?" is the question little snake Kosi asks most often. Being Kosi's mom must be exhausting. Mom thinks hard, trying to find something for her little snake to do. But Kosi is so smart—he learns things very quickly, and as soon as he learns something, he gets bored again. Every time he masters a new skill, he returns to his mom and asks the same question: "Mom, what should I do now?" Mom is exhausted. But little Kosi isn't tired at all—he says, "I'm bored!"

At this point in the story, parents can try asking their child: "What do you think boredom is?" "Can you help Mom the snake think of a good solution?"

The clever snake mom suddenly had a wonderful idea! She sent little Kosi to find a caterpillar to learn how to turn into a butterfly. Let your child guess boldly: Did Kosi learn this time? No matter what answer your child gives, don't negate it—just continue reading the story. When you read, "Mom the snake said, while gently coiling around little Kosi. One circle, two circles, three circles..." use your arms to hug your child once, twice, three times... gently embrace your little one! What a warm scene, as if it's right before your eyes! At this moment, your love for your child flows out, like flowers blooming in spring—sweet and happy. This is the power of love shown in the picture book, which subtly infects every reader, making us naturally open our hearts and express our truest feelings.

[P6] Emotions, and share wonderful parent-child moments with your child.
Children, like adults, have various emotions. Do you know? Sometimes the "boredom" or "pointlessness" children show is not misbehavior, but because they can't focus on one thing for a long time. If a child keeps asking you, "What should I do now?" and you keep giving suggestions, becoming increasingly frustrated, and finally angrily tell them, "Do whatever you want!" it means you can't accurately identify the emotional 'code' hidden in their behavior. The most effective way to help a child feel less bored is —— companionship. Little snake Kosi feels so comfortable in his mother's arms that he even forgets to ask, "What should I do now?" This is the power of companionship, which can alleviate a child's negative emotions.
Try holding your child close and reading the picture book "Little Snake Is Bored" together. Compared to simple lectures, children are more likely to empathize with the story's plot. Reading together allows you to subtly tell your child: There are truly many, many joyful and interesting things in this world! A mother's love is always the warmest, capable of overcoming boredom, helping the child feel cared for and happy.
(Shijiazhuang No.2 Kindergarten, Gu Hongyan)
